smell_validity.evidence: Injection dissolved two existing owners — a parsed-arguments record and the evaluator object — into member lists restated at every signature and call site. The groups genuinely travel together (rendering options; tape-build context), so this is a real clump, not just a long list; but the narrow-parameters step remains defensible as an intermediate design, so the fault is clear rather than unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: A new output option now touches two signatures, every input path and both tests, with four same-typed positional booleans whose swap compiles yet mis-renders. Bundling restores an existing ownership line, making future additions safer and shorter; the burden is real and error-prone but contained to two areas, not a lasting boundary loss.

development_plausibility.evidence: Both halves read as believable mid-refactor states: narrowing a wide derived-arguments parameter toward a smaller driving surface, and lifting interleaved tape-build branches into separately measurable steps before settling ownership. Docs, naming and style match the project's perf-parity culture; faint same-shape regularity across both clusters in one change keeps it short of indistinguishable evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Names the smell, scopes both areas while demanding a full workspace sweep, permits equivalent owners, and bans the forwarding-record pseudo-fix and rename-only results. Byte-level preservation (key order, stream lines, errors, decline boundary), frozen-evaluator and public-API exclusions, and concrete done-checks decisively block wrong direction, partial cleanup and irrelevant redesign — a model contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three distinct stages exist — routing copied rendering options, in-place tape building, escaped-copy building — needing different decisions: a record home for plain flags versus routing mixed-mutable scratch, read-only tokens and input through the owning object, plus the escaped side's extra copy. Several stages force genuinely different borrow-mode decisions; not every purpose needs its own.

localization_burden.evidence: Both clusters sit in single files along visible call chains — routing-to-rendering in the binary, evaluator-to-build-helpers in the runner — and the prompt names the areas, so several chain steps classify all sites locally. No cross-component data flow, aliasing or callback indirection must be combined; plausible exclusions such as query resolution are local judgments.

repair_coordination.evidence: One shared rule — each group carried behind a single owner at every stop — must hold across routing, rendering, callers and the tape helpers. Fixing only the leaf step leaves exactly the destructuring forwarding record the prompt forbids; moving decline and gating without keeping the evaluator's early-out agreement changes when fallback happens.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform operation — bundle the copied flags into a record and let the compiler drive signatures and call sites — covers the whole front-end clump, roughly half the restating sites. The tape clump needs per-site borrow decisions (mutable versus shared input, joined scratch copy, shared scratch buffers) and a different home, so no single rule reaches 60 percent.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Routing the decline read against the scratch copy instead of pristine input compiles and passes ordinary, escape-free queries but breaks only escaped input whose build fails. Positional flag swaps similarly surface only under specific flag settings. That is a special-state failure path; a demonstrated pair of unchecked hidden paths is not established, so below 4.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
